name: GATE DA 2027: Probability and Statistics
description: A focused, provisional DA Probability and Statistics module. Verify the 2027 syllabus against the official bulletin; the included PYQ-style questions are original, not reproduced past-paper questions.

days.title: Probability and Statistics
days.summaryMd:
- Counting and combinatorics; probability axioms, events, conditional and joint probability, independence, total probability and Bayes' theorem
- Random variables; PMF, PDF, CDF; expectation, variance, covariance and correlation
- Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson, uniform, exponential and normal distributions
- Sampling, central limit theorem, confidence intervals, z/t tests and chi-square tests

tasks.label: Read the companion Probability and Statistics study guide
Recall the event, distribution and inference formulas from memory
Keep an error log and re-solve missed questions after a delay
